title: AVEVA Process Optimization
overview: Affected Products AVEVA Process Optimization Vendor: AVEVA Product Version: AVEVA Process Optimization: <=2024.1 Product Status: known_affected Remediations Mitigation AVEVA recommends users take the following action: Vendor fix Update to AVEVA Process Optimization v2025 Mitigation AVEVA alternatively recommends the following actions users can take to mitigate risk: Vendor fix Apply Host and/or Network firewall rules restricting the taoimr service to accept traffic only from trusted source(s). By default, AVEVA Process Optimization listens on port 8888/8889(TLS). Please refer to the AVEVA Process Optimization Installation Guide for additional details on ports configuration. Mitigation Apply ACLs to the installation and data folders, limiting write-access to trusted users only. Vendor fix Maintain a trusted chain-of-custody on Process Optimization project files during creation, modification, distribution, backups, and use. Mitigation For more information, please Aveva's security bulletin AVEVA-2026-001.
